verdict.rationale: Unity does serve llms.txt files an agent can be pointed at: a site-wide '# Unity Documentation' index on docs.unity.com, a dedicated llms.txt for the Unity CLI docs, and a marketing-site llms.txt on unity.com. However, the core engine documentation at docs.unity3d.com (Manual and scripting docs) returns 404 for llms.txt and has no .md mirrors, so the bulk of engine docs is not agent-oriented. Missing for 10: llms.txt or markdown mirrors for the docs.unity3d.com engine Manual and scripting reference, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the docs.unity.com index.
